title: BenchLMM: Benchmarking Cross-style Visual Capability of Large Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing visual reasoning accuracy on common photographic images against diverse artistic styles (Cartoon, Painting, Sketch, Handmade, Tattoo) to measure performance degradation and overfitting to standard photo styles.
Evaluating the robustness of large multimodal models on images captured by non-RGB sensors (Infrared, X-ray, MRI, CT) compared to standard RGB camera images.

Testing model capability on specialized domain images (remote sensing, autonomous driving, defect detection) to measure reliance on common general knowledge distributions versus domain-specific visual applications.
